# Behavior

Timing knobs for one run. Every field is a `Jitter` range or a
probability because a constant is the thing a behavioral score reads.

A run picks a preset by name; a flow that needs one knob different sets it and the run reports `custom`.

| knob | meaning | `human` | `pace` | `off` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type_char_delay` | Gap between two keystrokes. | `Jitter(min_ms=30, max_ms=90)` | `Jitter(min_ms=30, max_ms=90)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `type_punct_pause` | Extra pause after a sentence mark — the gap a reader hears. | `Jitter(min_ms=120, max_ms=300)` | `Jitter(min_ms=120, max_ms=300)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `type_word_pause` | Extra pause at a word break. | `Jitter(min_ms=60, max_ms=180)` | `Jitter(min_ms=60, max_ms=180)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `type_word_pause_chance` | Share of word breaks that get that pause. | `0.15` | `0.15` | `0.0` |
| `pre_click_pause` | Pause before the pointer sets off. | `Jitter(min_ms=120, max_ms=400)` | `Jitter(min_ms=120, max_ms=400)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `hover_dwell` | How long the pointer rests on the target before pressing; also when a menu it opened finishes appearing. | `Jitter(min_ms=80, max_ms=300)` | `Jitter(min_ms=80, max_ms=300)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `press_hold` | How long the button stays down. | `Jitter(min_ms=60, max_ms=140)` | `Jitter(min_ms=60, max_ms=140)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `post_action_pause` | Pause after every action. | `Jitter(min_ms=200, max_ms=800)` | `Jitter(min_ms=200, max_ms=800)` | `Jitter(min_ms=0, max_ms=0)` |
| `click_offset_ratio` | How far off centre a click may land, as a fraction of the element's half-size. | `0.3` | `0.3` | `0.0` |
| `scroll_delta_jitter` | How far a wheel tick may stray from the delta asked for. | `0.15` | `0.15` | `0.0` |
| `mouse_move_steps` | Upper bound on the points sampled along a mouse path. | `20` | `20` | `0` |
| `mouse_move` | Move the pointer to the target instead of clicking in place. | `True` | `False` | `False` |
| `fill_as_type` | Make `fill` type its value rather than set it in one go. | `True` | `True` | `False` |
| `focus_drift` | Drift the pointer towards a field before typing into it. | `True` | `False` | `False` |
| `min_gap_ms` | Floor on the gap between two actions, so no two land back to back. | `0` | `0` | `0` |
